resources.string: Wikimedia Commons (featured pictures and the picture of the day), NASA (public domain) and Openverse (only CC0 and CC BY) work without a key. Pexels and Unsplash work only with your own key: it is stored only on this device. The program has no keys of its own and sends nothing personal: a request has only the topic. The author, the source and the license are shown small on the background (can be hidden). Downloaded pictures are kept in the cache (up to 20).
